Key.Chinesesimp: 你离敌人太近了！5秒内远离否则将暴露。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You fired a weapon.
Key.English: Disguise broken: You fired a weapon.

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You stayed too close to an enemy.
Key.English: Disguise broken: You stayed too close to an enemy.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你距离敌人过近且未及时远离。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: uniform, vest, helmet or weapon changed.
Key.English: Disguise broken: uniform, vest, helmet or weapon changed.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你更换了制服、背心、头盔或主武器。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: backpack is not enemy issue.
Key.English: Disguise broken: backpack is not enemy issue.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你更换了非敌军类型的背包。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: launcher is not enemy issue.
Key.English: Disguise broken: launcher is not enemy issue.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你装备了非敌军副手武器。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You drew a handgun that isn't enemy issue.
Key.English: Disguise broken: You drew a handgun that isn't enemy issue.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你装备了非敌军手枪。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: NVGs not enemy issue.
Key.English: Disguise broken: NVGs not enemy issue.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你装备了非敌军夜视仪。

Key.Original: Enemy disguise expired. You are now vulnerable.
Key.English: Enemy disguise expired. You are now vulnerable.
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人伪装已失效。你现在是正常状态。

Key.Original: Enemy disguise cooldown: %1 min %2 sec remaining
Key.English: Enemy disguise cooldown: %1 min %2 sec remaining
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人伪装冷却剩余：%1 分 %2 秒。

Key.Original: Enemy gear data not yet available.
Key.English: Enemy gear data not yet available.
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌军装备数据不可用，请稍等。

Key.Original: You must wear an enemy vest.
Key.English: You must wear an enemy vest.

Key.Original: You must wear an enemy helmet/headgear.
Key.English: You must wear an enemy helmet/headgear.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你必须佩戴敌军头盔/头饰。

Key.Original: You must equip an enemy primary weapon.
Key.English: You must equip an enemy primary weapon.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你必须装备敌军主武器。

Key.Original: Your vest does not match the enemy's.
Key.English: Your vest does not match the enemy's.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的背心不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your headgear does not match the enemy's.
Key.English: Your headgear does not match the enemy's.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的头盔不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your primary weapon does not match the enemy's.
Key.English: Your primary weapon does not match the enemy's.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的主武器不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your backpack does not match the enemy's.
Key.English: Your backpack does not match the enemy's.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的背包不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your secondary weapon does not match the enemy's.
Key.English: Your secondary weapon does not match the enemy's.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的副手武器不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your handgun does not match the enemy's.
Key.English: Your handgun does not match the enemy's.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的手枪不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your night vision goggles do not match the enemy's.
Key.English: Your night vision goggles do not match the enemy's.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的夜视仪不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: Too close to a corpse.
Key.English: Disguise broken: Too close to a corpse.

Key.Original: Disguise broken: Night vision goggles detected.
Key.English: Disguise broken: Night vision goggles detected.

Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装冷却剩余：%1 分 %2 秒。

Key.Original: The enemy is getting suspicious of you. Move away to a safe distance to maintain your disguise.
Key.English: The enemy is getting suspicious of you. Move away to a safe distance to maintain your disguise.
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人开始怀疑你的身份，迅速离开敌人到安全距离以继续伪装。

Key.Original: Hey, you! What are you doing sneaking around here?
Key.English: Hey, you! What are you doing sneaking around here?
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿...你！你在那鬼鬼祟祟的干什么呢...

Key.Original: I've got a suspicious guy here! All units, form on me!
Key.English: I've got a suspicious guy here! All units, form on me!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我发现了个怪人...所有人向我靠拢！

Key.Original: This is a warzone! Get back or I'll shoot!
Key.English: This is a warzone! Get back or I'll shoot!
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是战区，滚开！不然我就开枪了！

Key.Original: Hey you! Get over here! I haven't seen you around!
Key.English: Hey you! Get over here! I haven't seen you around!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，你！过来！我没怎么见过你！

Key.Original: You there! Nobody's supposed to be out here.
Key.English: You there! Nobody's supposed to be out here.
Key.Chinesesimp: 那边那个人，谁让你跑到战区来的？
伪装暴露：未穿着平民衣物。

Key.Original: Disguised as a civilian. Avoid suspicious actions.
Key.English: Disguised as a civilian. Avoid suspicious actions.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你已伪装成平民。请避免可疑行为。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: Too close to enemy.
Key.English: Disguise broken: Too close to enemy.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：距离敌人过近。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: Entered a non-civilian vehicle.
Key.English: Disguise broken: Entered a non-civilian vehicle.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：进入非民用载具。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: Recognised by the locals here.
Key.English: Disguise broken: Recognised by the locals here.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：负声望进入城镇——你的伪装在居住当地多年的民众面前不值一提。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: Not ready yet, try again shortly.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: Not ready yet, try again shortly.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法获取平民服装数据。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: Not available in this scenario.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: Not available in this scenario.
Key.Chinesesimp: 丧尸模式下无法伪装成平民。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are in a non-civilian vehicle.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are in a non-civilian vehicle.

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are carrying a weapon.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are carrying a weapon.

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are carrying night vision goggles.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are carrying night vision goggles.

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You aren't wearing any clothing.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You aren't wearing any clothing.

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are wearing a military uniform.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are wearing a military uniform.

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are wearing a military vest.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are wearing a military vest.

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are wearing military headgear.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are wearing military headgear.

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are carrying a military backpack.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are carrying a military backpack.

Key.Original: Partisan squad ready. Click on the map to select a deployment location.
Key.English: Partisan squad ready. Click on the map to select a deployment location.
Key.Chinese: 游击队准备好了，点击地图选择部署位置。

Key.Chinesesimp: 雇佣军事承包商 (15 纸币)
冷却剩余：%1 分 %2 秒。

Key.Original: %1 PMC operators hired and joined your squad.
Key.English: %1 PMC operators hired and joined your squad.
Key.Chinesesimp: %1 名军事承包商干员已加入你的小队。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, be advised. We have made contact with local military contractors. You now have external support.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, be advised. We have made contact with local military contractors. You now have external support.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组注意，我们跟当地的军事承包商取得了联系。你们有外援了。

Key.Original: %1 PMC operators are now under your command. Their gear varies from man to man. You can hire again in 15 minutes.
Key.English: %1 PMC operators are now under your command. Their gear varies from man to man. You can hire again in 15 minutes.
Key.Chinesesimp: %1 名军事承包商干员现已听你指挥。注意：干员的装备完全随机。每次雇佣间有15分钟的冷却时间。
冷却剩余：%1 分 %2 秒。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, %1 local volunteers have joined your squad.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, %1 local volunteers have joined your squad.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组，我们在当地发展了一些协助部队，%1 名志愿者加入了你的小队。

Key.Original: %1 partisans are now under your command. Their gear is whatever they could find. You can hire again in 30 minutes.
Key.English: %1 partisans are now under your command. Their gear is whatever they could find. You can hire again in 30 minutes.
Key.Chinesesimp: %1 名游击队现已听你指挥。注意：你的声望越高，一次能雇佣的游击队就越多(最多12名)。游击队的装备完全随机。每次雇佣间有30分钟的冷却时间。

Key.Original: You are already placing a partisan squad.
Key.English: You are already placing a partisan squad.

Key.Original: Click on the map to deploy your partisans. You cannot close the map until you choose a location.
Key.English: Click on the map to deploy your partisans. You cannot close the map until you choose a location.

Key.Original: One of our vehicles is damaged. Do you have a toolkit, or know where we can find one? We'll pay.
Key.English: One of our vehicles is damaged. Do you have a toolkit, or know where we can find one? We'll pay.
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿...你好朋友，我们是蓝军的。我们的车辆在维和行动里受损了...你，或者你周围的人有工具箱吗？我们可以出钱买一套。
维和？去你妈的！你得有多不要脸才能说出这几个字！

Key.Original: Take it. It's the only one we have.
Key.English: Take it. It's the only one we have.
Key.Chinesesimp: 给你这个工具箱，希望能帮上忙。(收下货币)

Key.Original: We've taken casualties. Can you spare any medical supplies? We'll pay for them.
Key.English: We've taken casualties. Can you spare any medical supplies? We'll pay for them.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你好老乡，我们是蓝军的...我们在维和行动里受了伤，你家里有医疗物资吗？我们可以付钱。

Key.Original: We've barely enough for our own. I can't help you.
Key.English: We've barely enough for our own. I can't help you.

Key.Original: Take it. It's not much, but it's what we have.
Key.English: Take it. It's not much, but it's what we have.

Key.Original: You lost the following on respawn: %1.
Key.English: You lost the following on respawn: %1.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你在重生时损失了以下物品：%1

Key.Spanish: Civil
Ven acá!

Key.Original: Alright, alright. What is it this time?
Key.English: Alright, alright. What is it this time?
Key.Spanish: ¡Sí, señor! ¡No dispare!
¡Oye tú! Ven aquí!

Key.Original: We're arming locals who'll fight. Will you come with us?
Key.English: We're arming locals who'll fight. Will you come with us?
Key.German: Hey, Kumpel... Wir sind von BLUFOR. Willst du für die Freiheit kämpfen? (reicht ihm ein paar Geldscheine)
Key.Spanish: Oye, amigo... Somos de BLUFOR. ¿Quieres luchar por la libertad? (dándole unos billetes)
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，朋友...我们是蓝军的，你愿意为了自由而战吗？(递过去几张纸币)

Key.Original: I've got people here who need me. Find someone else.
Key.English: I've got people here who need me. Find someone else.
Key.German: ...Wer zum Teufel will mit euch gehen? Ihr seid nur ein Haufen Banditen! (schlägt dein Geld auf den Boden)
Key.Spanish: ...¿Quién demonios quiere ir con vosotros? Solo sois un montón de bandidos! (golpeando tu dinero contra el suelo)
Key.Chinesesimp: ...谁他妈要跟你们走？一帮匪徒！(把你的钱拍在地上)

Key.Original: All right. I'll come with you.
Key.English: All right. I'll come with you.
Key.German: Na gut! Ich wollte diese Bastarde schon immer abschlachten! (nimmt die Geldscheine entgegen)
Key.Spanish: ¡Bien! ¡Siempre he querido matar a esos bastardos! (recibiendo los billetes)
Key.Chinesesimp: 行，我一直都很想杀光那帮杂碎！(接过纸币)

Key.Spanish: ¡Civil asesinado!
¡Manos arriba!

Key.German: ...? Was habe ich getan?? (hebt langsam die Hände)
Key.Spanish: ...? ¿Qué he hecho?? (levanta las manos despacio)
¡Jódete!

Key.Original: Documents found! Worth CP at the terminal.
Key.English: Documents found! Worth CP at the terminal.
Key.German: Heh... du Bastard... Hey! Ich habe etwas Interessantes gefunden!
Key.Spanish: Je... hijo de puta... Oye! He encontrado algo interesante!
Key.Chinesesimp: 哈哈...你这狗杂碎...嘿！我这儿找到了点有意思的！

Key.German: Das ist verdammter Krieg, Bruder... du brauchst das nicht.
Key.Spanish: Es una puta guerra, hermano... no necesitas esto.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这他妈是战争，兄弟...你不需要这些东西。

Key.Original: Have you seen any enemy movement around here? We'll pay for anything useful.
Key.English: Have you seen any enemy movement around here? We'll pay for anything useful.
Key.German: Hallo! Hast du die Position des feindlichen Abschaums gesehen? (zieht einen Stapel lokaler Geldscheine heraus)
Key.Spanish: ¡Hola! ¿Has visto la ubicación de los enemigos escoria? (saca un montón de dinero local)
Key.Chinesesimp: 你好老乡！最近有见到匪军的位置吗？(掏出一叠当地货币)

Key.Original: There's a few I know of. Marked them on your map.
Key.English: There's a few I know of. Marked them on your map.
Key.German: Äh... Ich weiß! Tritt diesen Abschaum richtig in den Arsch! Sie sind genau hier auf der Karte...(spricht, während er die Geldscheine nimmt)
Key.Spanish: Eh... ¡Lo sé! ¡Dales una buena paliza a esos escoria! Están justo aquí en el mapa...(hablando mientras coge los billetes)
Key.Chinesesimp: 呃...我知道！帮我狠狠踢那群杂碎的屁股！他们在地图的这里...(边说边收下纸币)

Key.Original: The civilian has joined your squad. Take them back to HQ for a reward. They may panic and break formation, so repeat the regroup command to keep them in line.
Key.English: The civilian has joined your squad. Take them back to HQ for a reward. They may panic and break formation, so repeat the regroup command to keep them in line.
Key.Chinesesimp: 平民已加入你的小队，带领他们返回基地以获得奖励。平民可能因恐慌而不受控制————多次下达集合命令以控制他们。

Key.Original: This civilian has already been approached.
Key.English: This civilian has already been approached.

Key.Original: Each evacuated civilian grants your team %1 CP.
Key.English: Each evacuated civilian grants your team %1 CP.
Key.Chinesesimp: 每个被撤离的平民都会带给你的队伍%1CP。

Key.German: Hey! Es ist hier gefährlich. Wir bringen dich an einen sicheren Ort!
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye! Es peligroso aquí. Te llevaremos a un lugar seguro!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿！这里很危险，我们带你去安全的地方！
Key.Original: It's not safe here. We'll get you to safety.
Key.English: It's not safe here. We'll get you to safety.

Key.Spanish: Superviviente

Key.German: Äh... okay! Ich folge euch! Alle sind durchgeknallt...
Key.Spanish: Eh... ¡vale! ¡Os seguiré! Todo el mundo se ha vuelto loco...
Key.Chinesesimp: 呃...好吧！我会跟着你们！所有人都疯了...
Key.Original: Uh... okay! I'll follow you! Everyone's gone crazy...
Key.English: Uh... okay! I'll follow you! Everyone's gone crazy...

Key.Spanish: ¡No te alejes!

Key.German: Das ist es. Ein Evakuierungshubschrauber wird euch gleich abholen.
Key.Spanish: Aquí es. Un helicóptero de evacuación os recogerá en breve.
Key.Chinesesimp: 就是这里了，待会会有撤离直升机接走你们。
Key.Original: This is it. An evacuation helicopter will pick you up shortly.
Key.English: This is it. An evacuation helicopter will pick you up shortly.

Key.Spanish: Gracias... gracias!

Key.German: Ich glaube euch nicht... Ihr seht nicht wie gute Menschen aus...
Key.Spanish: No os creo... No parecéis gente buena...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我不信...你们看着不像好人...
Key.Original: I don't trust your lot... You don't look like good people to me...
Key.English: I don't trust your lot... You don't look like good people to me...

Key.German: Ich kann nicht glauben, dass es Idioten gibt, die freiwillig an diesem gefährlichen Ort bleiben...
Key.Spanish: No puedo creer que haya idiotas que se queden voluntariamente en este lugar peligroso...
Key.Chinesesimp: 不敢相信还有蠢货自愿留在这危险的地方...
Key.Original: Hard to believe anyone would stay in a place this dangerous...
Key.English: Hard to believe anyone would stay in a place this dangerous...

Key.Spanish: Reputación incrementada !
Reputación reducida!
Action Squad, aquí "Overlord". Infección confirmada en tu zona. Se te permite abrir fuego contra los infectados a voluntad. Pero ten cuidado — la posibilidad de supervivientes no ha sido descartada.
Key.German: Action Squad, hier ist "Overlord". Infektion in Ihrem Gebiet bestätigt. Freies Feuer auf Infizierte genehmigt. Seien Sie vorsichtig — die Möglichkeit von Überlebenden ist nicht ausgeschlossen.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组。你的区域已被证实发生感染，你被允许对感染者自由开火。不过还是小心点————出现幸存者的可能尚未被排除。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1. Infection confirmed in your area. You're cleared to engage the infected at will, but stay sharp: there may still be survivors.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1. Infection confirmed in your area. You're cleared to engage the infected at will, but stay sharp: there may still be survivors.

Key.Original: Locals hear things. Whether they tell you depends on what this town thinks of you.
Key.English: Locals hear things. Whether they tell you depends on what this town thinks of you.

Key.Original: A medikit and three dressings, left at their feet.
Key.English: A medikit and three dressings, left at their feet.

Key.Original: A toolkit, left at their feet.
Key.English: A toolkit, left at their feet.

Key.Original: Arm them and take them along. They fight for the town's opinion of you, not for pay.
Key.English: Arm them and take them along. They fight for the town's opinion of you, not for pay.

Key.Original: Order them to the ground at gunpoint, then search them. The town will hear about it.
Key.English: Order them to the ground at gunpoint, then search them. The town will hear about it.

Key.Original: Nothing's free around here. %1 cash and it's yours, otherwise we're done.
Key.English: Nothing's free around here. %1 cash and it's yours, otherwise we're done.

Key.Original: I haven't seen anything. Don't ask me again.
Key.English: I haven't seen anything. Don't ask me again.
Key.German: ...(kurze Stille) Verpiss dich! (schlägt das Geld weg)
Key.Spanish: ...(breve silencio) ¡Jódete! (golpea el dinero y lo envía volando)
Key.Chinesesimp: ...(短暂沉默)滚开！(将钱打飞出去)

Key.Spanish: Informanten

Key.German: (Zzzzt...) Hallo? Kann mich jemand hören? Ich bin kompromittiert! Hilf mir, irgendjemand! Ich will nicht hier wegen ein bisschen Geld sterben!
Key.Spanish: (Zzzzt...) ¿Hola? ¿Alguien puede oírme? Estoy comprometido! Venid a ayudarme, cualquiera! No quiero morir aquí por algo de dinero!
Key.Chinesesimp: (Zzzzt...)喂？谁能听见我说话？我被发现了！快来帮帮我，谁都行！我不想为了点儿钱死在这！
Key.Original: (Zzzzt...) Hello? Is anyone on this channel? They know who I am. Somebody get out here — I'm not dying for your money.
Key.English: (Zzzzt...) Hello? Is anyone on this channel? They know who I am. Somebody get out here — I'm not dying for your money.

Key.German: Hier ist Overlord 1-1, identifizieren Sie sich, over.
Key.Spanish: Aquí Overlord 1-1, identifícate, over.

Key.German: Ich bin in eurer Nähe! Passt auf! Sie kommen gleich hinterher!
Key.Spanish: Estoy cerca de vosotros! ¡Cuidado! Vendrán justo detrás!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我在你们附近！看着点！他们马上就要跟过来了！
Key.Original: I'm close to you now. Watch out, they're right behind me.
Key.English: I'm close to you now. Watch out, they're right behind me.

Key.German: Ich bin euer Informant! Mein Rufname ist… Ich weiß es nicht mehr! Scheiße, kommt sofort her! Ich riskiere mein Leben für euch! Ihr habt gesagt, dass ihr mich am Leben erhaltet!
Key.Spanish: ¡Soy vuestro informante! Mi indicativo es… ¡No lo recuerdo! Mierda, venid ya! ¡Me juego la vida por vosotros! Dijisteis que me mantendríais con vida!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我是你们的线人！我的代号是...我忘了！妈的，你们快点过来！我是为你们卖命的，你们之前说过可以保我不死！
Key.Original: I'm your informant! My callsign is... I can't remember it. Just get someone out here. You told me you'd keep me alive.
Key.English: I'm your informant! My callsign is... I can't remember it. Just get someone out here. You told me you'd keep me alive.

Key.German: Diese Einheimischen machen einem immer das Leben schwer… Einsatztrupp, hier ist "Overlord". Ich brauche, dass ihr sofort aufbrecht und den Informanten beschützt, mit dem wir gerade gesprochen haben. Wenn er vom Feind gefangen genommen wird, gerät die Sache völlig außer Kontrolle.
Key.Spanish: Estos locales nunca dejan uno tranquilo… Equipo de Acción, aquí es "Overlord". Necesito que salgan inmediatamente para proteger al informante con el que acabamos de hablar. Si es capturado por el enemigo, el asunto se pondrá muy feo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这些当地人总是不让人省心...行动组。我需要你们立刻出发保护好刚刚的线人。万一他被敌人抓住，事情就闹大了。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1. Move now and get to the informant we just heard. If the enemy takes him alive, everything he knows goes with him.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1. Move now and get to the informant we just heard. If the enemy takes him alive, everything he knows goes with him.

Key.German: Ein Lieferwagen einer internationalen humanitären Organisation wurde von feindlichen Kräften beschlagnahmt. Wir müssen den Wagen zurückerobern und zur nahen Übergabestelle der internationalen humanitären Organisation bringen. (Low CP, no AP, high rep)
Key.Spanish: Un camión de suministros de una organización humanitaria internacional ha sido robado por las fuerzas enemigas. Tenemos que recuperar el camión y devolverlo al punto de entrega de la organización humanitaria internacional cercano. (Low CP, no AP, high rep)
Key.Chinesesimp: 国际公益组织的补给卡车被敌人抢走了，我们需要把卡车抢回来，并还给不远处的国际公益组织交付点。(低CP，无AP，高声望)
Key.Original:
Mission Type: Requisition
Enemy forces have seized a truck belonging to an international aid organization. Recover it and drive it to the aid delivery point nearby.

CP: 20
AP: 0
REP: +5
Key.English:
Mission Type: Requisition
Enemy forces have seized a truck belonging to an international aid organization. Recover it and drive it to the aid delivery point nearby.

CP: 20
AP: 0
REP: +5

Key.German: Hallo? Kann mich jemand hören? Hier ist IDAP. Vor einer Stunde wurde einer unserer Lieferwagen mit humanitärer Hilfe von OPFOR beschlagnahmt... Wir bitten Sie um Hilfe bei der Rückeroberung des Wagens. Seine ungefähre Richtung und der Übergabepunkt wurden auf dem GPS aktualisiert.
Key.Spanish: ¿Hola? ¿Alguien me oye? Soy IDAP. Hace una hora, uno de nuestros camiones de suministros cargado de ayuda humanitaria fue robado por OPFOR... Les pedimos ayuda para recuperar el camión. Su dirección aproximada y el punto de entrega han sido actualizados en el GPS.
Key.Chinesesimp: 喂？可以听到吗？我是IDAP的工作人员，一小时之前我们的一辆装满人道主义物资的补给卡车被红方抢走了...我们请求你们帮忙将卡车夺回来，卡车的大致去向和交付点已经在GPS上更新。
Key.Original: Hello? Can anyone hear me? This is IDAP. An hour ago OPFOR seized one of our trucks loaded with humanitarian aid... We need help getting it back. Its last known position and our delivery point are on your map.
Key.English: Hello? Can anyone hear me? This is IDAP. An hour ago OPFOR seized one of our trucks loaded with humanitarian aid... We need help getting it back. Its last known position and our delivery point are on your map.

Key.German: Hier ist BLUFOR-Kommando. Wir haben Ihre Anfrage erhalten. Einheiten sind zum markierten Ort unterwegs ———— "Overlord 1-1" an Einsatzteam, habt ihr die Übertragung alle verstanden?
Key.Spanish: Aquí mando BLUFOR. Hemos recibido su solicitud. Unidades en camino a la ubicación marcada ———— "Overlord 1-1" llamando al Equipo de Acción, ¿escuchasteis esa transmisión?
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们收到了你的请求。正在派出部队前往标记位置————"霸王1-1"呼叫行动组，刚刚的通话你们都听到了吧。
Key.Original: We have your request. Units are moving to the marked location. Alpha 1-1, you copy all that?
Key.English: We have your request. Units are moving to the marked location. Alpha 1-1, you copy all that?

Key.German: Einsatzteam verstanden, wir beginnen die Operation sobald der Plan festgelegt ist, Ende.
Key.Spanish: Equipo de Acción recibe, comenzaremos la operación una vez planificado, fuera.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组收到，我们规划完方案后就开始行动，完毕。
Key.Original: Copy. We'll move once we've got a plan. Out.
Key.English: Copy. We'll move once we've got a plan. Out.

Key.German: Vielen Dank! Zivilisten im Kriegsgebiet schätzen, was Sie getan haben!
Key.Spanish: Muchas gracias! Civiles en la zona de guerra agradecen lo que han hecho!
Key.Chinesesimp: 太感谢了！战区平民感激你们的所作所为！
Key.Original: Thank you. The people out here won't forget what you've done.
Key.English: Thank you. The people out here won't forget what you've done.

Key.German: Hier ist Einsatztrupp, verstanden. Unterwegs zum Zielort.
Key.Spanish: Aquí Equipo de Acción, recibido. En camino al lugar objetivo.

Key.German: Einsatztrupp an "Overlord", Informant vorerst sicher, over.
Key.Spanish: Equipo de Acción a "Overlord", informante seguro por ahora, over.
Key.Original: To Overlord, informant is secure for now, over.
Key.English: To Overlord, informant is secure for now, over.

Key.German: Verdammt, beeilt euch verdammt noch mal! Wenn ich gefangen werde, werden es auch eure Truppen hier bereuen!
Key.Spanish: Mierda, ¡apresúrense de una vez! Si me capturan, ¡vuestras tropas aquí también lo van a lamentar!
Key.Chinesesimp: 求求你们他妈的快点！我要是被抓到了，你们在这的部队也不会有好日子过了！
Key.Original: Hurry up, damn it. If they take me, you lose everything I've got for you.
Key.English: Hurry up, damn it. If they take me, you lose everything I've got for you.

Key.German: Wir haben einen Informanten, dessen Identität aufgeflogen ist. Er versteckt sich irgendwo in einem Gebäude. Geh dorthin und beschütze ihn, bevor der Feind ihn einholt und verhaftet — ja, wir können ihn noch nicht aus dem Gebiet evakuieren, weil wir ihn brauchen, um weiterhin vor Ort Informationen für uns zu sammeln. (Slightly low CP, no AP, high Rep)
Key.Spanish: Tenemos un informante cuya identidad ha sido expuesta. Se está ocultando dentro de un edificio en algún lugar. Ve allí y protégelo antes de que el enemigo lo alcance y lo arresta — sí, aún no podemos sacarlo de la zona, porque necesitamos que siga recopilando información para nosotros localmente. (Slightly low CP, no AP, high Rep)
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们有一个线人暴露了身份，他现在躲在某地的建筑物内。在敌人追上并逮捕他之前赶到那里保护他————是的，他还不能离开当地，我们需要他继续为我们收集情报。(稍低CP，无AP，高声望)
Key.Original:
Mission Type: Defence
One of our informants has been made and is holed up in a building somewhere in this area, with a hit team closing on him. Get to him and hold them off. No extraction: we need him in place and still gathering.

CP: 20
AP: 0
REP: +5
Key.English:
Mission Type: Defence
One of our informants has been made and is holed up in a building somewhere in this area, with a hit team closing on him. Get to him and hold them off. No extraction: we need him in place and still gathering.

CP: 20
AP: 0
REP: +5

Key.German: "Overlord 1-1" an Einsatztrupp. Der Informant ist tot. Zieht euch sofort zurück. Wir können nichts mehr tun.
Key.Spanish: "Overlord 1-1" a Equipo de Acción. El informante está muerto. Retrocedan de inmediato. No podemos hacer nada más.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组，线人死掉了你们就撤出来吧。我们也做不了更多了。
Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, the informant's dead. Nothing more we can do there — extract.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, the informant's dead. Nothing more we can do there — extract.

Key.Chinesesimp: 发现 %1 件物品！请检查你的背包。

Key.Original: Inventory full. Items dropped on the ground.
Key.English: Inventory full. Items dropped on the ground.
Key.Chinesesimp: 背包已满，物品已掉落在地面。
任务有效时间还剩5分钟

Key.Original: All units. Thirty minutes ago our assault hit an enemy command post in town. They're scrambling to recover the intel gear they left behind.
Key.English: All units. Thirty minutes ago our assault hit an enemy command post in town. They're scrambling to recover the intel gear they left behind.
Key.Chinesesimp: 战区所有单位。半小时前，我们的攻击行动击溃了敌人位于某城镇的临时指挥部，他们现在正在抢救他们部署在当地的情报设施。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, you're running the follow-up assault on the post. Allseer 1-1, you'll process whatever intel Alpha 1-1 recovers and handle the rest.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, you're running the follow-up assault on the post. Allseer 1-1, you'll process whatever intel Alpha 1-1 recovers and handle the rest.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组，你们负责稍后对于临时指挥部的再次进攻，"全视眼"，你们负责处理行动组带回来的情报以及任务后续工作。

Key.Original: Grab as much intel as you can before the enemy clears it out. Bring vehicles if you can; the post covers a lot of ground.
Key.English: Grab as much intel as you can before the enemy clears it out. Bring vehicles if you can; the post covers a lot of ground.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在敌人带着情报撤离前带回越多情报越好。另外，搞几辆载具过去最好————那个临时指挥部覆盖的范围相当大。
明白了，我们待会就出发。

Key.Original: Drone feeds show most of the enemy has pulled out of the post. Once you've got enough intel, extract and we'll call it a success.
Key.English: Drone feeds show most of the enemy has pulled out of the post. Once you've got enough intel, extract and we'll call it a success.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无人机显示大部分敌人都从临时指挥部撤离了。如果你们带回了足够多的情报就离开那里吧，任务可以宣布成功。

Key.Original: Overlord. We've found a classified document, looks highly sensitive.
Key.English: Overlord. We've found a classified document, looks highly sensitive.
Key.Chinesesimp: 呃...我们发现了一份疑似高度机密的情报文件

Key.Original: Copy. Bring it back, whatever it takes.
Key.English: Copy. Bring it back, whatever it takes.

Key.Original:
Mission Type: Requisition
Our assault scattered an enemy command post. What's left of them is bagging up their intel and pulling out. Search the buildings in this area and take whatever they haven't carried off. Allseer closes the mission out in 15 minutes.

CP: 5
AP: 5
Key.English:
Mission Type: Requisition
Our assault scattered an enemy command post. What's left of them is bagging up their intel and pulling out. Search the buildings in this area and take whatever they haven't carried off. Allseer closes the mission out in 15 minutes.

CP: 5
AP: 5
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人一个指挥部在我们的一次攻击行动后被打散了，他们正在收拾区域内的各类情报并逃脱。你的小队需要搜索区域内的建筑以获取情报物品。任务在15分钟后自动结束。(极低CP，极低AP)

Key.Original: Not enough suitable buildings in the area. Mission cancelled.
Key.English: Not enough suitable buildings in the area. Mission cancelled.
Key.Chinesesimp: 区域内可用建筑不足，任务已取消。

Key.Original: Overlord. We've just uploaded the latest intel to the data terminal.
Key.English: Overlord. We've just uploaded the latest intel to the data terminal.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们刚刚在数据终端上传了一批最新的情报。

Key.Original: Copy. Analysis team's on it. Good work.
Key.English: Copy. Analysis team's on it. Good work.
Key.Chinesesimp: "霸王1-1"收到，数据分析小组会好好看看它们的。干得漂亮。
你没有可分析的情报物品！
分析完成！获得 %1 CP。\n已分析物品：%2

Key.Original: %1 turned in intel: %2. The analysts pulled a location out of it.
Key.English: %1 turned in intel: %2. The analysts pulled a location out of it.

Key.Spanish: Inteligencia adicional obtenida

Key.Original: Intel recovered in the field. The pool gains %1 CP.
Key.English: Intel recovered in the field. The pool gains %1 CP.
Key.German: Du hast zusätzliche Informationen erfasst und %1 CP erhalten.
Key.Spanish: Has obtenido inteligencia adicional y ganado %1 CP.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你发现了额外的情报，获得了%1 CP

Key.Original: Intel found! Credited to the pool.
Key.English: Intel found! Credited to the pool.
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye! Encontré algo interesante!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿！我这找到点有意思的！

Key.Spanish: ¿Nada? Bueno…

Key.Original: Intel found! Position marked on your map.
Key.English: Intel found! Position marked on your map.

Key.Original: Intel recovered in the field. A new position is marked on your map.
Key.English: Intel recovered in the field. A new position is marked on your map.

Key.Original: Item dropped on the ground (no inventory space left).
Key.English: Item dropped on the ground (no inventory space left).
Key.Chinesesimp: 物品已掉落在地面 (玩家没有充足的库存空间)

Key.Original: Your black market order has been delivered to HQ.
Key.English: Your black market order has been delivered to HQ.
Key.Chinesesimp: 战区的黑市刚刚派人送了点东西到总部。谁买的？...我是说，好品味。

Key.Spanish: Demonio élite eliminado
Tu escuadrón ha obtenido %1 CP.
Juggernaut eliminado
Demonio élite eliminado

Key.Original: Due to your efforts, BLUFOR was awarded %1 CP.
Key.English: Due to your efforts, BLUFOR was awarded %1 CP.

Key.Spanish: Bonificación de CP: Zona capturada

Key.German: Zusätzliche CP und AP für das Erobern einer Zone erhalten
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到来自夺取战区的额外CP和AP
Key.Spanish: Recividos CP y AP adicionales por capturar una zona
Key.Original: Received additional CP and AP for capturing a zone.
Key.English: Received additional CP and AP for capturing a zone.

Key.Spanish: Bonificación de CP: Misión secundaria completada
Bonificación de AP: Misión secundaria completada
CP Bonus received!
Key.Original: Command Points awarded for completing a side mission.
Key.English: Command Points awarded for completing a side mission.

Key.Original: Army Power awarded for completing a side mission.
Key.English: Army Power awarded for completing a side mission.

Key.English: Your death has cost BLUFOR %1 CP.

Key.Original: Permanent supports are bought for the team and cannot be handed back.
Key.English: Permanent supports are bought for the team and cannot be handed back.

Key.Original: All %1 support slots are in use. Refund one to free a slot.
Key.English: All %1 support slots are in use. Refund one to free a slot.

Key.Original: That vehicle is already your Mobile HQ. Deploy it where you want the crate and the respawn point, or use Release Mobile HQ on it to designate a different vehicle instead.
Key.English: That vehicle is already your Mobile HQ. Deploy it where you want the crate and the respawn point, or use Release Mobile HQ on it to designate a different vehicle instead.

Key.Original: Last Mobile HQ destroyed. Name another in %1 min
Key.English: Last Mobile HQ destroyed. Name another in %1 min

Key.Original: An ordinary truck again. Any squad lead can claim a new one
Key.English: An ordinary truck again. Any squad lead can claim a new one

Key.Original: Your radio supports died with you. %1 CP recovered.
Key.English: Your radio supports died with you. %1 CP recovered.

Key.Original: BLUFOR has unlocked the VA Arsenal
Key.English: BLUFOR has unlocked the VA Arsenal

Key.Original: BLUFOR has unlocked the Mobile HQ
Key.English: BLUFOR has unlocked the Mobile HQ

Key.English: BLUFOR has unlocked Forward Operating Bases

Key.English: BLUFOR has unlocked the Vehicle Modification Station

Key.English: BLUFOR has unlocked the Vehicle Recycling Station

Key.English: BLUFOR has built a Radio Tower

Key.English: BLUFOR has upgraded to Radio Tower II
